newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Far Eastern hits intraday price rise limit.
newsitem.headline: Far Eastern hits intraday price rise limit.

text.p: The Philippine Stock Exchange had frozen any further price rise of Far Eastern University after the company's shares hit the 50 percent daily fluctuation limit at 375 pesos, a bourse official said on Friday.
Only 70 shares had been traded when the price hit 375 pesos, up from the previous close of 250 pesos.
The stock exchange had asked Far Eastern to explain the sharp price hike, the official said.
Far Eastern officials were not immediately available for comment.
